function.name: echo_random_number
function.description: Generate a random integer within a specified range (default 1–100) and return it as a string.

function.name: fetch_github_user
function.description: Fetches the public GitHub profile information for a given username.

username.description: The target GitHub username to query (e.g., 'Khoinguyen002').

function.name: calculate_message_tokens
function.description: Calculates the approximate number of tokens in a given text message using a simple heuristic (roughly 4 characters per token). Returns the token count as an integer.

text.description: The message text to calculate token count for.

function.name: compare_message_length
function.description: Compares two messages and returns which is longer or if they are equal.
